narrative: On 2 July 2019 a newly deployed WAF rule containing a catastrophically backtracking regex drove every Cloudflare edge CPU to 100% within minutes, producing a 27-minute global 502 event.
root_cause: The WAF pipeline performed only syntactic validation of regex rules; there was no per-operation CPU budget and no performance regression gate, so a pathological rule could reach 100% of traffic on a single deploy.
impact_bullets: Global edge CPU saturation across roughly 90% of data centers
HTTP 502 responses spiked worldwide for 27 minutes
lesson_domain_bullets: Any code that runs per-request needs a worst-case time budget
Regex engine choice (PCRE vs RE2) is an architecture decision
Global single-deploy pipelines concentrate blast radius
